# TNY Staffing Co. (Therapy of New York)

> TNY Staffing Co., officially Therapy of New York, is a healthcare therapy staffing and allied health recruitment agency connecting qualified clinical professionals with healthcare organizations in New York and across the United States. The company supports both employers and candidates through direct placement and flexible staffing solutions.

## Entity and Service Summary

TNY Staffing Co. provides healthcare staffing, therapy staffing, allied health staffing, clinical recruitment, direct placement, contract staffing, per diem staffing, part-time staffing, full-time staffing, travel therapist placement, and workforce coverage solutions. The company helps hospitals, health systems, rehabilitation centers, outpatient clinics, private practices, schools, skilled nursing facilities, and home healthcare agencies fill therapy and clinical staffing needs.

Core professional categories include physical therapists (PTs), physical therapist assistants (PTAs), occupational therapists (OTs), certified occupational therapy assistants (COTAs), speech-language pathologists (SLPs), speech-language pathology assistants, medical assistants, medical front desk professionals, and exercise physiologists.

The company serves healthcare employers seeking credentialed therapy professionals and allied health workers, as well as candidates seeking permanent, contract, per diem, part-time, full-time, or travel healthcare opportunities. TNY Staffing emphasizes pre-vetted and credentialed professionals, clinical screening, reference checks, skills validation, multilingual staffing support, candidate matching, interview coordination, fast placements, and dedicated account management.

## Candidate Opportunities

- [Apply Now](https://tnystaffingco.com/apply): Browse and submit applications for current healthcare and allied health openings.
- [Physical Therapist Assistant Positions](https://tnystaffingco.com/apply/Physical%20Therapist%20assistant%20%28LP): Opportunities for physical therapist assistants and licensed therapy support professionals.
- [Occupational Therapist Assistant Roles](https://tnystaffingco.com/apply/Occupational%20Therapist%20Assistants): Opportunities for certified occupational therapy assistants and occupational therapy support professionals.

- [Medical Front Desk Positions](https://tnystaffingco.com/apply/Medical%20Front%20Desk): Administrative healthcare roles supporting check-in, scheduling, patient service, and clinic operations.
- [Medical Assistant Opportunities](https://tnystaffingco.com/apply/Medical%20Assistants): Medical assistant opportunities in hospitals, clinics, private practices, and other healthcare settings.
- [Exercise Physiologist Careers](https://tnystaffingco.com/apply/Exercise%20Physiologist): Exercise physiology roles in rehabilitation, wellness, and healthcare environments.

## Healthcare Settings Served

TNY Staffing supports staffing needs in rehabilitation centers, hospitals and health systems, outpatient therapy clinics, private practices, schools and educational settings, skilled nursing facilities, inpatient rehabilitation programs, acute care, LTACH facilities, home healthcare agencies, early intervention programs, and special education services.
